postings.title: Senior Back-End Engineer
postings.description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.




MEET THE TEAM!

Join Preply’s Teams and help us power people’s progress through life-changing learning experiences. We’re on a mission to combine the magic of the best tutors with cutting-edge AI to create personalized journeys that keep learners motivated and inspired. Together, we’ll transform how students expand their vocabulary, master conversational fluency, and deepen comprehension - unlocking their full potential and sparking a lifelong love for learning. Are you ready to make an impact? Let’s redefine education!

The Preply Engineering Team provides the tools to help unlock human potential through learning.

We implement A/B tests to prove the value of our initiatives and improve our product based on data and students and tutors feedback. As part of our commitment to ensuring high-quality products, we prioritize monitoring and metrics analysis to identify areas for optimization and ensure our services are performing at their best. 

We are tech-agnostic, meaning we are open to considering candidates with diverse technology backgrounds, such as Java/Spring, Node.js/Express.js, Ruby/Ruby on Rails, Scala/Play, PHP, or Golang.

While Python is our primary programming language, prior experience with it is not mandatory. What truly matters is your enthusiasm for learning Python and your ability to adapt quickly to using it for product development.

At Preply, we release our product 50-60 times per day by leveraging top-notch CI/CD processes. As a fast-growing company we have diverse technical challenges (sometimes we even write about them on our Engineering Blog) that will allow you to develop your skills at scale. 

We’ve reached 90%+ adoption of AI coding tools across engineering, and we’re now moving towards more autonomous, AI-Augmented development at scale. At Preply, engineers have direct access to the best tools available, with the freedom to use them fully and experiment as they build





WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You will work in a cross-functional team alongside the Product Manager, Product Designer, UX Writers, Data Analytics, Technical Leads, Engineers and other cross-functional team members to deliver engaging features through A/B tests and build top-notch products, including, but not limited to:

 - Develop and own backend features using Python/Django, supporting the creation of new backend services as well as design, create, and/or troubleshoot integrations with third-party vendors.

 - Think beyond the code and about our customers, understand their needs and define solutions with the team;

 - Balance short-term speed of development with the long-term technical quality of our systems;

 - As a Senior Engineer, you will leverage your experience to guide the team in making informed technical decisions, such as continuous improvement of best practices (test culture, code reviews, monitoring and scalability of our tools). 



WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

 - Exposure to architectural patterns of a large, high-scale web application (e.g., well-designed APIs, high-volume data pipelines, efficient algorithms);

 - AI Expertise: You're a forefront user of Agentic AI. You're able to bring hands on experience and start influencing the team beyond code generation; reserving judgment for architecture, business logic, and security, using AI as a thought partner and able to set up quality gates and safety nets to enhance existing engineering workflows and propose AI-native alternatives.

 - Familiar and willing to support small JS/TS tasks when needed;

 - Expertise in troubleshooting issues, identifying the root cause, mitigating it, and adding setting up safeguards to prevent future issues;

 - High level of self-organization, ownership, and responsibility;

 - A great collaborator with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Minimum B2 English level;

 - Willingness to be on-call for your squad (1 week every 5 weeks).



WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT AT PREPLY

 - An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;

 - A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com http://preply.com/, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;

 - A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;

 - Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub;

 - Access to free mental health support platforms;

 - Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;

 - The opportunity to shape the lives of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).
   
   

#LI-KD2


OUR PRINCIPLES

 - Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

 - We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

 - Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

 - Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

 - Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

 - Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

 - Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

 - Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

 - Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

 - One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

Preply.com http://Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

MEET THE TEAM! 

At Preply, AI isn't a feature — it's foundational. It powers how we connect millions of learners and tutors, personalise every interaction, and build a marketplace where meaningful learning thrives at global scale. 

The Applied AI team sits at the centre of this ecosystem. We design and deploy intelligent systems that drive real-time tutor–learner matchmaking across millions of sessions worldwide. Over time, we've evolved from traditional machine learning approaches into a modern AI-native marketplace — leveraging deep learning, advanced ranking and re-ranking architectures, and proprietary multimodal data including audio, video, and transcripts to deliver smarter recommendations and measurable learning outcomes. 

Our scope extends far beyond recommendations. We build and operate the intelligence layer that ensures the marketplace is not only high-performing, but also safe and trustworthy. From neural ranking models in PyTorch to large-scale experimentation infrastructure and full-spectrum Trust & Safety systems, including fraud prevention, abuse detection, and marketplace integrity, we tackle some of the most complex and high-impact challenges in the business. 

As part of Applied AI, you'll partner closely with product, engineering, and data leadership to bring cutting-edge research into production at scale. This is where state-of-the-art modelling meets real-world constraints, and where every incremental model improvement translates into better matches, stronger trust, and real progress for learners and tutors around the world.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

 - AI Research & Development: Apply state-of-the-art, multimodal neural search & Ranking models to build and optimize scalable machine learning solutions for personalized learning and AI tutors.

 - Applied Science Execution: Work on cutting-edge AI models, contributing to research, prototyping, and deployment in production environments.

 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver AI-driven solutions that improve learning experiences and business outcomes.

 - Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing: Support and mentor junior scientists and engineers, fostering an environment of learning and innovation.

 - Best Practices in ML: Contribute to machine learning best practices, including model architecture, research methodologies, and deployment pipelines.

 - PhD in Information Retrieval (IR), NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

 - 4+ years of industry experience, focusing on deep learning-based NLP and IR applications.

 - Strong proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud).

 - Ability to drive AI initiatives from research to production in a collaborative environment.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and a track record of building impactful AI solutions.

 - Passion for advancing AI-driven personalized learning experiences.

 - Partner with Product Managers and channel owners to shape a shared plan, translating strategic direction into the detailed roadmap that makes it happen

 - Bring senior stakeholders clear recommendations, why we should and shouldn't do something, and the judgment of how it will land, then commit and drive it to results

 - Define success with Data, and own the narrative for why a number moved or didn't

 - Tutor behaviour change and adoption, getting tutors to adopt the tools and teaching practices that will improve their performance and their learners' outcomes

 - Tutor sentiment and trust, how tutors receive what we roll out, whether launches and campaigns land well and build belief in Preply rather than adding noise

 - You've done go-to-market or adoption work hands-on, across multiple channels

 - You have a track record of driving measurable behaviour change amongst large audiences, not just running communications or campaigns

 - You have 4-6 years in growth, lifecycle, GTM, or audience engagement

 - You have a strong orchestration instinct: can break down the communication goal in a complex, sequenced, multi-channel, multi-stakeholder plan.

 - You operate with independent judgment, bringing senior stakeholders a recommendation and the tradeoffs, not options to choose from or work to approve

 - You have excellent written and verbal communication, with sharp judgment on clarity and tone

 - Hands-on experience collaborating with community engagement teams, alongside other channels

 - Experience translating internal product and policy decisions into audience-facing behaviour change

Preply's B2B segment is a growing vertical, and this is a newly created role to strengthen its analytics capabilities. You will own B2B analytics projects, such as LTV, retention analysis and B2B reporting, from problem definition to recommendation, with a day-to-day focus on retention, renewals and customer value. You will work alongside the Staff Data Analyst and Data manager for B2B, who leads company-level and cross-domain questions. You'll partner across Product, Ops, Engineering, Sales, Account Management and RevOps, and occasionally contribute to company-level questions when they touch B2B influencing B2B roadmap and strategy.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an analytics role at the intersection of product, business and finance, focused on what drives long-term B2B growth, retention and unit economics, and on turning that into decisions teams and leadership act on. You will work directly with Directors and VPs on B2B trade-offs, and your analysis is expected to change what gets built, priced or prioritised.

Getting there means building the trusted data layer first. In the first 6–12 months you will review and fix B2B metrics and data quality, improve reporting so teams can self-serve, and deliver the analyses behind the year's priority decisions. By month 12, success looks like a B2B metric set leadership uses without caveats and a renewal-risk view the Account Management team acts on.




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 - Own retention, renewals and customer value analytics for B2B: lead cohort, renewal and customer-activity analyses that answer priority business questions, and turn findings into concrete pricing, product or lifecycle recommendations.

 - Develop the analytical frameworks B2B teams and leadership use to evaluate trade-offs and spot opportunities for growth, retention and expansion.

 - Build impact models and scenario analyses for priority B2B initiatives, supporting planning and decisions with clear assumptions, trade-offs and limitations.

 - Own LTV/CAC for B2B and the metrics behind it (NRR, GRR, CAC, CAC payback): build the model, keep it honest, and make sure the business understands what it can and cannot say.

 - Define and review B2B metrics with business stakeholders: purpose, calculation logic, data quality and edge cases. Document agreed definitions and drive consistent use across teams.

 - Maintain the trusted B2B data layer: build and maintain analytical models in dbt and Looker, and investigate data-quality issues with RevOps, Salesforce owners and Analytics Engineering, validating how they affect reporting and analysis.

 - Partner with business and product teams to define hypotheses, prioritise experiments and agree how success will be measured. Analyse results and explain what the evidence supports and where uncertainty remains, including when a clean experiment isn't possible.

 - Decide what should be self-serve and build only what changes behaviour: dashboards and reports stakeholders use independently, validated with them.

 - Prioritise analytical work based on business impact and align on clear commitments, partnering with stakeholders across Product, Ops, Engineering, Sales, Account Management and RevOps to understand business needs and turn insights into actions. Share knowledge and support other analysts.


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

 - You can point to a specific decision (a pricing change, a resourcing call, a roadmap cut) that happened because of your analysis, and explain how you took it from an unclear business question to a validated recommendation and how you assessed the result afterwards.

 - You understand B2B or account-based business models, including acquisition, contracts, renewal, retention and expansion, and you are fluent in NRR, GRR, CAC and CAC payback. Subscription or marketplace experience counts if you can apply it to B2B questions.

 - Experience defining or reviewing business metrics, investigating data-quality issues and agreeing calculation logic with stakeholders.

 - You have built an LTV, cohort or revenue forecast model yourself, not only interpreted one someone else built, and you can explain its assumptions and where it breaks.

 - Strong SQL and solid data-modelling experience. You can independently build, maintain and validate analytical models, and you review others' SQL and dbt rather than waiting for review.

 - Applied statistics for customer behaviour, retention and experiments. You distinguish association from causation, explain uncertainty and measurement limits, and know what to do when you can't randomise: pre/post with controls, matched cohorts, difference-in-differences, or an honest decision-grade approximation.

 - Strong critical thinking, stakeholder management and communication: you clarify the business need behind a request, challenge assumptions constructively, and agree priorities based on business value. You explain findings, assumptions and limitations clearly to different audiences, including Directors and VPs, and propose practical next steps.

 - Experience translating business questions into useful dashboards and reports with a BI tool, and validating them with users using storytelling with data principles.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Direct experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise businesses.

 - Hands-on dbt in production.

 - Experience improving analytics practices: documentation, data-quality checks, self-service reporting, KPI frameworks.

 - Experience with Looker.

 - Master's or PhD in a quantitative field.

   - Design a unified measurement framework that ties MMM, attribution, and incrementality together; MMM for big budget calls, incrementality-adjusted attribution for channel splits.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Senior Director of Tax to build our global tax function from the ground up as we scale toward becoming a public company. Operating in 180 countries, our business is inherently cross-border and complex. This is not a role to optimise an existing function - it is an opportunity to design, build, and lead one.

This leader will play a critical role in developing, implementing, and managing a robust global tax framework that supports rapid growth, ensures full compliance, and advances the company's IPO readiness. As a senior member of the finance team reporting directly to the VP of Accounting (CFO-1), the Senior Director of Tax will oversee global tax compliance, reporting, structuring, and planning across all jurisdictions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical tax expertise with the judgment to prioritize effectively across a highly complex international footprint - knowing where to go deep, where to engage external advisors, and where a pragmatic approach is the right call. They thrive in high-growth environments, have experience building or scaling tax functions in complex multinational settings, and are energized by ambiguity and pace.

This is a career-defining opportunity to build the tax function of a global, technology-enabled company at a pivotal inflection point in its growth journey.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Build and Scale the Global Tax Function Lead the design, build-out, and scaling of Preply's global tax exposure and tax team from its early-stage foundations.

 - Lead Global Tax Compliance & Reporting Manage worldwide direct and indirect tax compliance, including income tax provision (ASC 740), transfer pricing, VAT/GST, withholding, 1099/DAC7 reporting, and local statutory requirements. Ensure timely and accurate filings while strengthening documentation, controls, and processes in preparation for future SOX readiness.

 - Apply a Risk-Prioritised Approach to Global Compliance Exercise rigorous cost-benefit judgment across a highly complex international footprint.

You will help define the current and future direction of Preply’s ML platform, set technical standards, and design the systems that allow ML teams to move from research to production quickly, safely, and cost-efficiently.

Your impact will come not only from the systems you design, but from the standards you set, the engineers you mentor, and the technical decisions you help de-risk across the organization.


WHY IS THIS ROLE IMPORTANT:

Preply’s next stage of growth depends on making AI a scalable company-wide capability, not a collection of isolated models and experiments. This role will define how ML systems are built, deployed, monitored, and improved across the company.

You’ll shape the platform that powers personalized learning, smarter experiences for tutors and learners, marketplace intelligence, content generation, automation, and future GenAI products. The goal is to make it dramatically easier for teams to turn ML ideas into reliable, secure, cost-efficient product experiences at a global scale.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

 - Define the technical vision and roadmap for Preply’s ML platform, ensuring it can support growing ML and GenAI adoption across multiple teams, products, and business lines.

 - Lead the architecture of platform capabilities across the full ML lifecycle: experimentation, feature engineering, artifact management, training, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and governance.

 - Design cloud-native infrastructure for distributed training and inference, including GPU-based environments, autoscaling, workload isolation, rollout strategies, and cost optimization.

 - Set the technical direction for CI/CD for ML, embedding testing, validation, security, performance checks, and release confidence into deployment pipelines.

 - Establish observability standards for ML systems, including model metrics, service health, alerts, drift detection, data quality, lineage, and business-impact monitoring.

 - Lead the evolution of Preply’s GenAI and LLM platform capabilities, including building LLM Gateway services, vector retrieval infrastructure, prompt experimentation, evaluation frameworks, latency-optimized inference, and reliable model-serving patterns.

 - Partner with Applied Science and Data leads, Product leaders, and Engineering teams to align platform investments with experimentation velocity, cost efficiency, operational reliability, and user impact.

 - Design platform abstractions, internal libraries, templates, and self-service tooling that help ML Scientists and engineers move faster without compromising reliability or security.

 - Act as a technical multiplier across engineering by mentoring senior engineers, influencing architecture, raising standards, and guiding teams through complex platform decisions.

 - Identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the path from ML research to production, making the platform easier, safer, and more efficient for all ML-powered product development.




WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:  

 - 9+ years of engineering experience, with significant depth in large-scale ML, data, infrastructure, or platform systems.

 - Proven ability to architect and scale production-grade ML platforms that support many teams, workflows, and ML use cases.

 - Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture and end-to-end ML workflows, including experimentation, feature management, model versioning, training, deployment, monitoring, performance benchmarking, and lifecycle management.

 - Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, Kubernetes, distributed compute, CI/CD, observability, and infrastructure-as-code practices.

 - Experience building enabling tools and platform capabilities for Applied Scientists, Data Scientists, and engineering teams.

 - Strong technical judgment and the ability to make pragmatic architecture decisions across reliability, scalability, security, cost, and developer experience.

 - Excellent communication and influence skills, with experience aligning cross-functional stakeholders and translating platform strategy into execution.

 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, raise engineering standards, and multiply the impact of teams around you.

 - Product-impact mindset: you care about building platform capabilities that accelerate experimentation, improve user experiences, and unlock measurable business value.

At Preply, we take pride in having the largest and most diverse base of tutors among all online learning platforms. Our tutors are central to our vision of powering people's progress, and how we communicate with, enable, and engage them directly shapes the learning experience for millions. When we get this right, tutors grow their skills, reach their own professional and financial goals, and stay motivated to keep teaching at their best.

The Supply Engagement team owns how Preply changes tutor behaviour at scale, through three levers working together: communications, community, and learning. This role owns the strategy that ties them together. You decide what matters most among everything competing for tutors' attention, sequence it, and design how each behaviour change gets driven, from the launch of a new tool, policy, or programme through the ongoing campaigns and education that drive tutors to adopt it and change how they teach and run their tutoring business on Preply. You don't operate the channels yourself; you set the strategy and collaborate with the specialists such as copywriters, community managers, and trainers who bring it to life. You own the roadmap end to end and keep it on track.

What you'll be doing:

 - Own the strategy for how Preply drives tutor behaviour change and tool adoption across launches, policies, and programmes

 - Own the tutor engagement calendar: decide what reaches tutors, what waits, and in what sequence, without overwhelming the audience

 - Design cross-channel strategies across communications, community, and learning, working with the specialists who deliver them

 - Partner with Product Managers and channel owners to shape a shared plan, translating strategic direction into the detailed roadmap that makes it happen

 - Bring senior stakeholders clear recommendations, why we should and shouldn't do something, and the judgment of how it will land, then commit and drive it to results

 - Define success with Data, and own the narrative for why a number moved or didn't
   

The outcomes you'll own:

 - Tutor behaviour change and adoption, getting tutors to adopt the tools and teaching practices that will improve their performance and their learners' outcomes

 - Engagement outcomes of major launches, programmes, and campaigns (for example, tool adoption rates, performance, event registrations)

 - Tutor sentiment and trust, how tutors receive what we roll out, whether launches and campaigns land well and build belief in Preply rather than adding noise

 - You've done go-to-market or adoption work hands-on, across multiple channels

 - You have a track record of driving measurable behaviour change amongst large audiences, not just running communications or campaigns

 - You have 4-6 years in growth, lifecycle, GTM, or audience engagement

 - You have a strong orchestration instinct: can break down the communication goal in a complex, sequenced, multi-channel, multi-stakeholder plan.

 - You operate with independent judgment, bringing senior stakeholders a recommendation and the tradeoffs, not options to choose from or work to approve

 - You drive cross-functional work without authority, aligning teams behind a shared plan through clarity and influence

 - You bring structure to complex, fast-moving work, setting up the systems, sequencing, and ways of working that keep multiple streams on track

 - You have comfort using data to size opportunities, set targets, and explain results

 - You have excellent written and verbal communication, with sharp judgment on clarity and tone

 - Hands-on experience collaborating with community engagement teams, alongside other channels

 - Strong user empathy, especially for solopreneurs who earn through a platform or run their own business

 - Familiarity with marketplace or complex multi product environments: segments with competing needs, quality and liquidity

 - Experience translating internal product and policy decisions into audience-facing behaviour change

 - Understanding of brand voice and tone in a global, multicultural organisation

 - Operate fluidly across altitudes: set direction with leadership one moment, and make sharp technical calls the next.

 - Plan ahead, anticipating what a fast-scaling company will need from IT 12 to 18 months out, and building toward it. Implement control adequate for a pre-IPO level company.

2. AI-native operations and automation

 - Bring an AI-first, automate-first mindset to how IT runs: provisioning, access, support deflection, and asset reconciliation.

 - Lead by example. Build and ship automations yourself, and show both your team and the wider company what good looks like.

 - Continuously surface AI tooling that makes employees’ lives easier, with a clear, opinionated view on where it adds value and where it’s just noise.

 - Bring those AI-native ways of working to the rest of the organization, not just to IT.

 - Lead, grow, and mature a lean IT team into a senior, process-driven function.

 - Raise the technical bar across the team, coaching toward more technical, AI-fluent ways of working.

 - Stay hands-on where it counts: scripting, automation, and MDM and identity configuration.

 - Build the operating rhythm (SLAs, runbooks, prioritization) that lets the team scale its impact without scaling headcount one-for-one.

 - Own international fleet and device lifecycle end to end, from procurement and enrollment to retirement, across multiple countries.

 - Drive cost and compliance efficiency: eliminate shadow IT, consolidate overlapping tools, and negotiate from a position of data.

6. Data, dashboards and stakeholder management

 - Build dashboards and reporting that give leadership a clear, current view of IT health, spend, and the status of every initiative.

 - Provide crisp, proactive follow-ups on where things stand, so leadership never has to chase.

 - Manage and influence C-level stakeholders directly, translating technical reality into business decisions.

 - Make decisions from data, not anecdotes.

 - Co-own the identity lifecycle in Okta: joiner, mover and leaver flows, periodic access reviews, least privilege and separation of duties.

 - Enforce endpoint compliance baselines in Jamf and keep control evidence audit-ready.

 - Share ownership of AI tool governance: evaluation, approval and allow lists for anything new entering the environment.

With great power comes great responsibility. Our product managers have true end-to-end accountability for their area with varied areas of responsibility such as: setting the long term vision and strategy for the squad, conceptualizing the product(s), driving the daily execution with the team, launching and analyzing the impact of your product on our customers.

Preply is one of the largest advertisers in the Education Tech space. Our marketing operations span dozens of languages, thousands of creatives, and multiple acquisition channels.    - Run a fast cycle of hypothesis, experiment, learning across geographies, audiences, and channels.

 - Make Preply Marketing AI-native
   
   - Make AI a first-class building block in the platforms you ship. From keyword and ad copy generation, to page creation, to creative automation - AI is the engine that makes scale possible. Architect for it from day one rather than retrofitting it later.
   
   - Be the standard-bearer for AI inside the Marketing org - proactively identifying where AI compounds marketer output and be hands-on building solutions.
   
   - Build the platform and guardrails that let every marketer at Preply operate with AI safely and effectively in their daily work.
   
   - Stay close to the frontier of AI capabilities, and translate what's possible into what's worth shipping.

 - Be a domain authority: Inspire your squad and cross-functional partners by articulating a bold vision for how Tech can scale marketing channels far beyond what's possible today.

 - Go deep into the system: Own the platform at the depth of an engineer. Query the tables yourself, read the data pipelines, design the architecture alongside the team. Open the marketing platforms (Google Ads, Meta, GSC) and see the performance with your own eyes. The best decisions in MarTech come from PMs who understand the system as well as the people building it.

Our team collaborates closely with various other chapters - including product, business, and platform - leveraging analysis, experimentation, causal inference, and machine learning.

 

You’ll be embedded in cross-functional teams, partnering with our MarTech Product Manager, Marketeers, Tech Leads, and the Data Strategy team. Check out our Tech Radar https://tech-radar.preply.com/ to see the tools and technologies we love using at Preply!

 


ABOUT THIS ROLE:

This role requires a real interest in the marketing bidding universe and the ability to work with a lot of ambiguity. You will go deep into each channel, understand its bidding and optimization behavior, and derive data driven solutions to increase each channel's ROI through bidding, audience and creative optimization. Marketing brings the business questions, you define the success metrics and the modeling approach to answer them. A lot of this is untapped territory and there is nothing off the shelf to buy, so inventing the approach and convincing your stakeholders of it is a big part of the job.





WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

 - Design our Creative Analytics framework (creative performance modeling) - Own, design and develop our Creative Analytics Framework. Drive its findings into decisions with the creative and media-buying teams, and automate detection, reporting and action with MarTech. Longer term, build models that separate what a creative actually causes from what the algorithm’s delivery decides for it, so we can predict the incremental drivers of creative efficiency.

 - Cohort maturity prediction (conversion-lag prediction) - Minimize steering delay: predict how many of today’s clicks will convert, and connect today’s spend to conversions that haven’t happened yet.

 - Bidding signal optimization (value-based bidding) - Work with our channel managers and Applied AI team to improve the predicted conversion value we send to Google and Meta, iterating through which funnel events we optimise on and what predictions we attach to them. Predict too early and the signal is noisy, too late and the algorithm doesn’t get enough data to learn from.

 - Audience optimization (uplift modeling) - Create customer uplift models to identify incremental value and build audiences that improve marketing efficiency. Tell the networks who to look for and who to skip, and feed that back as prospecting seeds, remarketing audiences and exclusion lists.

 - Work closely with the Data Engineering and Applied AI team on scalable data pipelines, the evolution of our ETL processes, and the adoption of new tools and frameworks.


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:

 - Python, SQL and a distributed framework like Spark; we use Databricks.

 - Experience with marketing or attribution data, and a working understanding of how bidding platforms consume the signal you send them. You don't need to have run campaigns, but you should find how they behave genuinely interesting.

 - Advanced modelling. Propensity models to value earlier funnel events and refine targeting, and uplift models to identify incremental value.

 - Causal inference and experiment design. Separating what a channel drives from what it takes credit for, and designing the test that settles it when the platform controls delivery.

 - The instinct to turn a business hypothesis into something testable, and the honesty to say when the data can't answer it.

 - Comfort working across teams you don't control. This role runs on close collaboration with Applied AI, marketing measurement, MarTech and tracking, and CRM.

You might come from marketing DS, ads ML, recommender systems or any applied ML role where your model’s output fed another algorithm.

 - Set the tooling strategy and standards across the organization: decide what we adopt, consolidate, and retire, and articulate why.

 - Operate fluidly across altitudes: set direction with leadership one moment, and make sharp technical calls the next.

 - Plan ahead, anticipating what a fast-scaling company will need from IT 12 to 18 months out, and building toward it. Implement control adequate for a pre-IPO level company.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

MEET THE TEAM!

AI Platform provides the shared foundations that help teams across Preply build, ship, and operate AI capabilities safely at scale. The area includes ML Platform, GenAI Platform, and Agentic Platform. You will lead GenAI and Agentic Platform: approximately 8-12 engineers across two teams, while partnering closely with ML Platform leadership.

GenAI Platform owns shared model access, routing, evaluation, observability, prompt and configuration lifecycle, retrieval, grounding, and guardrails. Agentic Platform builds on those foundations with durable execution, tools, state, context, memory, permissions, human controls, agent evaluation, and runtime safety.

The two teams share a Product Manager. Together, you will shape strategy, priorities, adoption, and outcomes; clarify what belongs in shared infrastructure versus product teams; and evolve the platform as models, frameworks, and company needs change. 

Learn more through our Engineering Blog https://medium.com/preply-engineering, Tech Radar https://tech-radar.preply.com/, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Preplyengineering-ie3bb channel.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

GenAI and Agentic AI are central to Preply's AI strategy. As the Senior Engineering Manager for GenAI & Agentic Platforms, you'll own the engineering strategy, execution, and organizational health of two complementary teams that take AI workloads from experimentation to reliable production systems.

This is a multi-team leadership role for a manager with strong technical judgment. You won't be the primary implementer, but you'll go deep on architecture and production AI, coach senior engineers, shape platform abstractions and operational standards, and partner with Product, Applied Science, Data, Security, and Engineering teams.

 

In this role, your responsibilities include:

You’ll own Preply’s Marketing Mix Model end to end, the system that governs how we allocate marketing’s largest cost line, a 9-digit annual spend, across more than 30 markets and channels. You’ll partner directly with Finance to turn model output into the budget steering process, and with performance marketing to translate it into channel strategy.

Within a year, you’ll have built a hierarchical model spanning our top markets, calibrated where possible against existing geo-experiments, and actively shaped the measurement roadmap by identifying, designing, and running the next tests needed to further calibrate it.    - Steer the testing roadmap that feeds the MMM: use its signals to pick which channels and questions to test, then design and run incrementality tests (geo experiments and other causal inference methods) to measure incremental ROI.
   
   - Design a unified measurement framework that ties MMM, attribution, and incrementality together; MMM for big budget calls, incrementality-adjusted attribution for channel splits.

 - Extend these causal inference methods beyond marketing, as a reusable foundation for how Finance and Product measure impact.

 - Work with Data Engineering to build scalable pipelines and evolve our ETL as the modeling stack grows (e.g. adopting Databricks).

 - Strong grounding in Bayesian statistics, applied with rigor to MMM and causal inference.

 - Built or owned at least one of: a marketing mix model, a geo-experimentation program, or another causal measurement system that steered real budget, with experience turning its outputs into action in language marketing and finance can use.

This role requires a real interest in the marketing bidding universe and the ability to work with a lot of ambiguity. You will go deep into each channel, understand its bidding and optimization behavior, and derive data driven solutions to increase each channel's ROI through bidding, audience and creative optimization. Marketing brings the business questions, you define the success metrics and the modeling approach to answer them. A lot of this is untapped territory and there is nothing off the shelf to buy, so inventing the approach and convincing your stakeholders of it is a big part of the job.





WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

 - Design our Creative Analytics framework (creative performance modeling) - Own, design and develop our Creative Analytics Framework. Drive its findings into decisions with the creative and media-buying teams, and automate detection, reporting and action with MarTech. Longer term, build models that separate what a creative actually causes from what the algorithm’s delivery decides for it, so we can predict the incremental drivers of creative efficiency.

 - Cohort maturity prediction (conversion-lag prediction) - Minimize steering delay: predict how many of today’s clicks will convert, and connect today’s spend to conversions that haven’t happened yet.

 - Bidding signal optimization (value-based bidding) - Work with our channel managers and Applied AI team to improve the predicted conversion value we send to Google and Meta, iterating through which funnel events we optimise on and what predictions we attach to them. Predict too early and the signal is noisy, too late and the algorithm doesn’t get enough data to learn from.

 - Audience optimization (uplift modeling) - Create customer uplift models to identify incremental value and build audiences that improve marketing efficiency. Tell the networks who to look for and who to skip, and feed that back as prospecting seeds, remarketing audiences and exclusion lists.

 - Work closely with the Data Engineering and Applied AI team on scalable data pipelines, the evolution of our ETL processes, and the adoption of new tools and frameworks.

 - Python, SQL and a distributed framework like Spark; we use Databricks.

 - Experience with marketing or attribution data, and a working understanding of how bidding platforms consume the signal you send them. You don't need to have run campaigns, but you should find how they behave genuinely interesting.

 - Advanced modelling. Propensity models to value earlier funnel events and refine targeting, and uplift models to identify incremental value.

 - Causal inference and experiment design. Separating what a channel drives from what it takes credit for, and designing the test that settles it when the platform controls delivery.

 - The instinct to turn a business hypothesis into something testable, and the honesty to say when the data can't answer it.

 - Comfort working across teams you don't control. This role runs on close collaboration with Applied AI, marketing measurement, MarTech and tracking, and CRM.

 - Coordinate the team’s weekly prioritization process, highlighting conflicting priorities, dependencies and capacity risks.

 - Identify repetitive coordination tasks that could be simplified or automated, including follow-ups around deadlines, reviews, and handovers.

 - Gather feedback and improve these processes as the volume and complexity of work increase.

 - Turn useful individual experiments into simple, reliable workflows that the wider team can adopt.

 - Create simple automations, dashboards and integrations between tools.

 - Track introduced measures such as adoption, time saved, delivery improvements and quality.

 - Make Preply’s voice principles easier to apply at scale through practical guidance, systems and checks.

 - Help the team use available performance data to improve copy quality, effectiveness and decision-making.

 - Establish clear processes for multilingual copy projects, partnering with Localization so requests, reviews and decisions move smoothly.

 - Develop repeatable processes for supporting copy in new subjects, markets and languages.

 - Turn ambiguous operational problems into simple, testable solutions.

 - Build the team’s confidence and capability in using AI responsibly and effectively.
